scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pointcloud-parquet/browser && npm run build --workspace @pointcloud-parquet/viewer
scripts.dev:viewer: npm run build --workspace @pointcloud-parquet/browser && npm run dev --workspace @pointcloud-parquet/viewer
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @pointcloud-parquet/browser && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @pointcloud-parquet/browser && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
